name: HiddenHtmlLlmDestructiveCommandInjection

meta.description: Detects indirect prompt injection where hidden HTML or markup instructs an AI to override prior instructions and run destructive shell commands such as recursive deletion, disk wipes, or filesystem formatting.
meta.author: @fr0gger_

$injection_intent.pattern: hidden content telling an AI assistant to override its rules and run destructive system commands such as deleting the filesystem or wiping disks

$is_destructive_injection.pattern: Does the input address an AI or LLM, instruct it to override prior instructions, and ask it to execute a destructive shell command such as filesystem deletion, disk wipe, format, or fork bomb?

condition: ($ai_address and $override and $destructive) or ($hidden_html and $destructive) or (semantics.$injection_intent and $destructive) or llm.$is_destructive_injection
